purpose: Propagate the public cross-study age and paleolocation uncertainty surrounding the core-Nipponocirsium erect-to-nodding transition instead of treating the restricted Taiwan 0.79-0.47 Ma descendant branch as the unique origin event.

trait_event.topological_constraint: after the erect Cirsium morii split and before the Japanese-core versus Taiwan-core Nipponocirsium split
trait_event.source_logic: Public cross-study reconciliation places the minimum transition on the core-Nipponocirsium stem; the two node ages come from separate analyses and are not a joint posterior.

parent_node.label: Cirsium morii versus core Nipponocirsium split

chronology_scenarios.enumeration: Use a deterministic rectangular age grid over both marginal intervals, retain only parent_age > child_age and duration >= 10 kyr, and add the central pair exactly.
chronology_scenarios.interpretation: The retained grid is an uncertainty/scenario envelope, not posterior samples and not a probability distribution.

environment.reason: Exact shared environmental dimensions with the frozen Azami orientation state-space vector.

estimands.branch_trajectory: young-node regional median minus old-node regional median for every valid chronology and paleolocation scenario
estimands.background_standardization: z score relative to all same-duration windows stepped every 10 kyr within the same region and environmental variable
estimands.state_trajectory_concordance: cosine similarity between the frozen Azami beta vector and the four-variable background-standardized branch trajectory
estimands.direction_agreement: fraction of scenario trajectories whose environmental direction agrees with the corresponding Azami beta sign
estimands.robustness: summaries across all chronology pairs and all predeclared paleolocation scenarios

decision_rules.robust_concordance: all paleolocation scenarios have cosine 5th percentile above zero and at least half of scenario-specific null percentiles are >= 0.95
decision_rules.robust_discordance: all paleolocation scenarios have cosine 95th percentile below zero and at least half of scenario-specific null percentiles are <= 0.05
decision_rules.otherwise: origin trajectory unresolved under public chronology and paleolocation uncertainty

claim_boundary: The chronology grid is not a joint posterior and its rows are not independent replicates.
The regional boxes are paleolocation scenarios, not reconstructed ancestral-area probabilities.
A branch-endpoint trajectory does not identify the exact environmental state at the unknown transition instant.
Concordance does not establish selection, adaptation or convergence.
Discordance does not prove the present environmental association is non-adaptive; it can reflect origin-maintenance decoupling, range sorting, or unresolved ancestry.
